free_tier_limits.correction: Free access is segmented: commercial evaluation currently includes up to 15 Historic Time Series and 10 Live and Forecast requests at the user's locations, plus unlimited requests at unmetered locations. Separate home-hobbyist and researcher programs have different limits.

rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are plan- and product-specific, are displayed in the Solcast API Toolkit, and return HTTP 429 when exceeded.

notes: The API and legacy World API are operational, but the example uses the legacy /world_radiation/estimated_actuals path rather than the endpoint in the current reference. It also requests no JSON format while showing a JSON response. Current free allowances are published and vary by program.
